name: Sawdust Hound
flavor: A ring dog gone feral, coat matted grey with sawdust, ribs like tent poles under the fur.

features.name: Runs in a Pack
features.description: It has advantage on its Bite against a creature that is within 5 feet of another Sawdust Hound.

tactics: Never alone — three or four, and they circle. They go for whoever is furthest from the rest, and they run rather than die: at 3 hit points or fewer a Hound breaks off and bolts for the dark under the seating.
narration: It does not bark. It waits at the edge of the lamplight with its head low, and the sawdust falls off it in a fine grey rain when it finally moves.
